description_expanded: OverviewHot TubPrivate Pool - Walk to Seaside - Public Beach - 2 Minute Bike Ride - `Dogwood Daze`The SpaceSpacious 5BR/5.5BA Beach House + Carriage House (Sleeps 16!)QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Private Pool (Heat Optional) – Enjoy a swim in your own oasis Newer Construction – Modern, high-end finishes throughout Expansive Outdoor Living – Huge patios, porches, and balconies 3 Indoor Living Areas – Plenty of space to relax & entertain 6 Complimentary Bikes – Explore 30A in style Ping Pong Table – Fun for all ages! 6-Seater Golf Cart Rental Option – Cruise to Seaside & beyond Professionally Managed, 24/7 Service – Stress-free vacationing Driveway Parking for 3 Vehicles – Private & convenientWelcome to Dogwood DazeJust one street over from Seaside and only a few houses up from the beach, 239 Dogwood is a spacious 5 bedroom/ 5.5 bath beach house that can accommodate 14 comfortably. With the addition of the carriage house, this home will sleep 16! This centrally located new construction offers private parking, a gorgeous front porch balcony and huge back patio with pool!As you make your way into the home you will be greeted by the spacious living room, kitchen, and dining room. This brand-new kitchen has everything you need. Stainless steel appliances, granite counter tops and a gas range are just a few of the highlights of this gorgeous kitchen. The huge dining table has seating for 10-12 with an additional 5 seats at the eat in bar!The cozy living room will be just what your family needs to relax and unwind after a long day at the beach.Also, on the first floor you will find one of the many master bedrooms with King sized bed and en suite bathroom with walk in shower.The patio off the kitchen is complete with a large dining table and direct access to the homes private heated pool!Head on up the gorgeous set of stairs onto the second floor. This floor has three bedrooms including a master bedroom with king sized bed and private en suite bathroom. This master bedroom has a porch that overlooks the pool. The second master on this floor also has a king-sized bed and en suite bath. There is also a balcony off this bedroom as well! The third and final bedroom is a bunk room with two sets of twin over two queen beds with a shared bath.The second floor also boasts a second living area with couches, TV and a huge balcony with porch swing and seating area.One more flight of stairs will take you to the master bedroom oasis. On this floor you will find a HUGE master suite with King sized bed, huge bathroom with separate soaking tub and walk in shower and double vanity. The third floor also has a living area with cozy sofas, a wet bar, and a huge balcony. The balcony has plenty of seating and a ping pong table.Spend your vacation at this gorgeous brand-new home and make memories that will last your family a lifetime!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**Pool Heat*Pool heating available for this property from October 1st through May 1st*Fee $50 per day and required for length of stay*Pool heat is not guaranteed-please note pool and hot tub cannot be heated at the same time.*Please choose to heat one option; pool or hot tub for your stay.*No Cable. Streaming Only**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (16):1st floor - Master Bedroom - King sized bed, en suite bathroom with walk in shower2nd floor - Master Bedroom - King sized bed, en suite bathroom with walk in shower2nd floor - Master Bedroom - King sized bed, en suite bathroom with stand-up shower2nd floor - Bunk room - 1 bunk, twin over twin bed, 1 bunk, queen over queen bed, shared bath with tub/shower combination3rd floor - Main Master - King sized bed, en suite bathroom with separate soaking tub and walk in showerCarriage house - Master - King sized bed, private bathroomCarriage House - sleeper sofa in living roomAREA ATTRACTIONS:Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back.Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand. Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.Show less
